answer: An agent marketplace can anchor participation to a fixed collateral bond locked for 30 days per active identity. Agents named raven and atlas face the same rule: each account must fund its own bond before bidding for work. Creating 1,000 fake identities therefore requires 1,000 bonds, tying up capital for the full lock period. Splitting funds across accounts cannot reduce that total, so a sybil swarm carries a proportional financing cost.
